identification: Unsigned (in the photo) dusk bush river oil, portrait format, approx 35 x 25 cm, dead white gums at left, dense bush and a yellow afterglow reflected in still water; modern gilt frame with grey slip. Catalogued only as 'attributed' to Ernest William Christmas (1863-1918, Australian/NZ landscape painter). The style fits the late-19th/early-20th c. Australian twilight bush genre that Christmas worked in, but there is no signature or initials, and the frame is a modern replacement. This is the same painting offered by Armitage two weeks ago (sale 28975 lot 793, closed 11 Nov 2026, est A$140-200), now back with a lower estimate (A$100-150), so that sale probably fell through or it has been flipped.
